item.title: Bynum introduces bill for small business refunds after Trump admin's 'reckless' tariffs
item.description: Democratic Congresswoman Janelle Bynum (OR-05) introduced a bill on Friday aiming to help small businesses impacted by tariffs imposed by the Trump administration.

item.title: Gov. Kotek asks Trump for disaster declaration after December storms
item.description: Oregon Governor Tina Kotek is calling on President Trump for a major disaster declaration after the December storms that raged across the state.

item.title: PacifiCorp pays $575M settlement for negligence during Labor Day 2020 fires
item.description: PacifiCorp has agreed to pay $575 million in a settlement for allegedly starting six wildfires in Oregon and California in 2020, which burned nearly 95,000 acres of federal land.

item.title: 'Time to fight is now': Oregon Congresswoman Hoyle announces re-election campaign
item.description: Democratic Oregon Congresswoman Val Hoyle (OR-04) announced her decision to run for re-election Friday – vowing "the time to fight is now," against the Trump administration.

item.title: AG Rayfield reacts to SCOTUS decision that Trump's tariffs were unlawful
item.description: The Supreme Court struck down the tariffs introduced by President Trump, and Oregon's Attorney General Dan Rayfield celebrated the decision, noting that the president had attempted to use an emergency statute to impose the tariffs unlawfully.

item.title: 'Made me so mad': Longview students accused of rape in varsity locker room appear in court
item.description: Two teenagers were charged with second-degree rape, unlawful imprisonment with sexual motivation, and indecent liberties with forcible compulsion after allegedly sexually assaulting junior varsity players at Mark Morris High School in Longview, Washington.
